steps.title: Welcome to PKO XP: Gaming!
steps.description: I'm your guide. I'll teach you how to defend against digital threats!

steps.title: Your Character
steps.description: This is you! You're a cyber defender protecting people from online scams.

steps.title: The Threat
steps.description: These are the scammers and digital threats you need to defeat!

steps.title: Health Bars
steps.description: Keep your health up! If it reaches zero, you lose. Defeat enemies by reducing their health.

steps.title: Decision Cards
steps.description: These phone screens are your actions. You can play 2 cards per turn to defend yourself!

steps.title: Adventure Progress
steps.description: Track your progress through the adventure. Complete all encounters to win XP!

steps.title: Earn XP!
steps.description: Win adventures to earn XP! Use XP to unlock and upgrade cards in "Invest in Yourself".

steps.description: Use your cards wisely to identify and stop digital threats. Good luck!
